meta.title: dkitchen
meta.description: Run a kitchen of DeepSeek Harness sessions: create stations, hand out tickets, launch long jobs, and read what came back.

setupNote: The bundle only mounts dkitchen's tools. The Python package provides them, so these two commands are still yours to run:
agentMessage: The dkitchen bundle is installed. dkitchen's tools live in the Python package: install it with `pipx install dkitchen`, then run `ding plugin install` to create the kitchen profile and add the route bundles.
